title: Trash to Treasure
description: Whenever you create a Status, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random Orb.
smart_description: Whenever you create a Status, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]X[/blue] random Orb(s), where X equals this power's stack count.
notes: Triggers whenever the player creates a Status card. Channels a random Orb from the full orb pool. The stack amount determines how many Orbs are channeled per Status created.
